0022600165.text: The Pelicans are 1-4 and sit 12th in the West and 4 games back in fifth place in the Southwest, while the Grizzlies are unbeaten at 5-0, lead the West and the Southwest, and are on a five-game winning streak. New Orleans will be without Dejounte Murray (personal), Jordan Poole (ankle sprain), and Yves Missi (knee bruise), all listed as out. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the Pelicans' 114-106 win in New Orleans on January 30, 2026 being the most recent meeting.
